title: TermRover 1.1: The Herdr Agents Fleet is here
excerpt: Meet the Herdr Agents Fleet in TermRover 1.1. Find agents across your SSH hosts and work between machines from your iPhone, iPad, or Android device.
content_html:
Herdr’s Connecting the machines introduced a fleet that spans machines. Now you can bring that fleet experience to mobile with TermRover. Introducing the Herdr Agents Fleet.

Just one day after Herdr 0.9, your fleet has a home on iPhone, iPad, and Android.

All your hosts. One herd.

TermRover probes the saved SSH hosts you choose, looks for Herdr, and brings their agents together in one view. See what’s working and who needs your input, then move between machines without losing your place on your phone.

Tap an agent to start typing in a fullscreen terminal over SSH or Mosh. Need the surrounding panes? Open its workspace in the same terminal. Browse by machine, or keep favourite agents and workspaces together for quick access. Your agents keep running on their hosts when you leave.

A mobile terminal that cares about the details

We’re building TermRover to be the best mobile terminal for tmux and Herdr. That means caring about things like pane-aware text selection: drag to select an agent’s response, and copy just that pane’s text, without grabbing its neighbour’s output. A small detail that makes a big difference on a touchscreen.

Add voice prompts and screenshots, and you can give an agent the context it needs without opening your laptop.

Open Herdr Agents Fleet from the Hosts screen, choose your hosts, and meet your herd.
